_finding: Outside review, 25.11: a failed or stale KV read let a run write tripped:false over a trip. The trip is now its own key, written once and never by a run; a store that could not be read is no run; a trip that was read is always obeyed, with no bypass; a broken store on a request lets it pass.

mutations.name: a failed read is taken as a fresh start
mutations.expect: FAIL a failed read of the store is no run

mutations.name: a run takes the trip from the state it read

mutations.expect: FAIL a run that read an old state cannot clear the trip
